indicator_name: Nominal effective exchange rate of the tenge, consumer-import and total-import weights (2020 = 100, up = appreciation)
description: Номинальный эффективный курс тенге с весами потребительского и всего импорта (2020 = 100, рост = укрепление)
methodology: Geometric chain of monthly changes of 18 NBK official rates, weights = previous year's import shares by partner currency (UN Comtrade reported by Kazakhstan; euro-area members from euro adoption; Ecuador, Panama, El Salvador, Hong Kong to USD); partners without an NBK rate dropped, weights renormalised among currencies quoted in both months. From 1995-12 (weights of 1995, Kazakhstan's first year in Comtrade, used from 1996-01; the rates reach back to 1993-11). Before 1999 the euro-area partners have no rate in the table (Germany ~9% of 1998 imports) and coverage is 59-77% against 80-90% from 2000; 1995-1999 CONSUMER weights include passenger cars (HS1992 conversion to BEC 522) and CONSUMER 2000 is a partial Comtrade conversion, so 2001 uses the 1999 structure. NEER_CONSUMER: BEC 112, 122, 522, 61, 62, 63 -- the pass-through-relevant basket (Russia ~31%, China ~24% of 2024 consumer imports); NEER_TOTAL: all goods. Coverage and weights by year in NEER_IMPORT_WEIGHTS. Differs from the NBK NEER (trade weights of exports and imports, IMF-style).
